proposedDirectGuards.directReason: The actualそら lexical object and modern Daijisen noun sense2 explicitly include weather; actual current Russian天気 caption is погода.
The actualそら sense4 includes mental state/mood, oftenそらもない; actual current気 caption includes настроение. Not a claim that every気 idiom allows空.
The same directly inspected mood sense overlaps actual настроение in気分's compound label; not a claim that空 means every physical illness.

Russian actual unqualified бассейн also denotes artificial water bodies for aquatic animals/other uses; the source池 explicitly includes man-made garden ponds. Partial Russian overlap, not every pond being a swimming pool.

Actual unqualifiedцвет has a separately attested collective blossom/flowering-plant-part sense, matching花's ordinary flower/blossom sense. Not Japanese花 meaning colour or automatic transfer of the Russian elite sense.
The complete猫 object explicitly records wheelbarrow as an abbreviation of猫車. Actual current車 caption includes the broad транспортное средство. Not Japanese猫 ordinarily meaning an automobile.

Both actually inspected lexical objects have ordinary rushing/fleeing/run-off senses; actual newбежать; бегать can defensibly overlap飛ぶ in the fleeing/rushing use. Preserve literal flight and jumping teaching.
Actual baselineидти inидти; ехать fits the ordinary walking sense of歩く. Preserve walk versus general going; not every行く implies walking.
Actual vehicle-motion走る includes a moving train; actual baselineидти; ехать is defensible for that vehicle motion. Running on foot is not simply walking.
Actual散歩 object is noun/suru/intransitive for a walk/stroll; actual newходить пешком fits that walking activity. Not every歩く is recreational or a universal noun/verb equivalence.
Actual吹く includes playing wind instruments; unqualified newиграть in遊ぶ's actual label is defensible for that instrument use. The Japanese verbs are not generally interchangeable.

Actual吹く object sense7 explicitly records bursting into laughter, taggedSlang, notArchaic. Actual unchanged笑う label includesсмеяться. Keep the colloquial qualifier and primary blowing teaching distinct.
Ordinary Russian precipitation usesидти; actual baseline行く caption is unqualifiedидти; ехать. Not a claim that Japanese行く ordinarily describes rainfall.
Actual降る object also records luck/misfortune coming/arriving. Actual baselineприходить inприходить; приезжать is defensible for that sense, not a reading change toおりる.
Actual Russianотдыхать includes spending vacation/free time, not only physical recovery;遊ぶ's inspected recreation/idle senses overlap that actual current label. Not every rest means play.
Actual走る includes flashing/streaking lightning; actual unqualifiedсверкать inсиять; сверкать is defensible for lightning flashing. Not transitive closure of all light words.
The same directly inspected lightning-flash use admits actual unqualifiedсверкать inмерцать; сверкать; do not claim every movement or every bright room is twinkling.
